lumiere.description: All-in-one management system for beauty centers. Robust appointment, stock, and user control.
lumiere.challenge: Digitalizing a complex physical scheduling system to eliminate booking conflicts and centralize service management.
lumiere.architecture: Development based on the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern to ensure scalability and clean code maintenance.
lumiere.security: Friendly URLs via .htaccess, passwords hashed with password_hash, session-protected admin endpoints and XSS-safe output.
lumiere.database: Normalized relational schema (MySQL) featuring automated triggers for real-time inventory updates after each service.
lumiere.note: Final project of my DAW degree (2022), framework-free MVC architecture. Revised in 2026: security hardening, PHP 8 compatibility and a Docker setup.

bookyBloom.description: Interactive digital library built with Kotlin. PDF catalog management and real-time reader community.
bookyBloom.functionality: PDF rendering engine with integrated download capabilities for seamless offline reading.
bookyBloom.stackInfo: Full Firebase integration: Realtime Database for user interaction and Storage for binary file hosting.
bookyBloom.uxui: Native Android interface with full Dark Mode support and Material Design-based navigation.
bookyBloom.roles: Differentiated permission system separating administrative management tools from the end-user reading module.
bookyBloom.note: This project was developed under native architecture with Firebase, focusing on persistence and real-time synchronization.

matchaTest.description: Multiple-choice exam simulator for university students. No accounts, no server: everything is stored in the browser.
matchaTest.challenge: Practising with each course's real exam rules (wrong-answer penalties, pass mark, time limit), which change from one syllabus to another.
matchaTest.functionality: Configurable scoring engine, a syllabus reader (PDF/TXT) that detects penalties and duration, Mock Exam, Practice and Review Deck (Leitner system) modes, and progress statistics.
matchaTest.architecture: Local-first app built with Vue 3 and TypeScript: question banks, history and review deck persist in IndexedDB. Import from JSON or Markdown, plus exportable backups.
matchaTest.uxui: Keyboard shortcuts during exams, sessions that survive page reloads, and a clean, distraction-free design for studying.
matchaTest.note: My own idea and design, born from my needs as a university student.
